---
title: "Are the ALS TSS switches 5' truncation? Read lengths and read ends by cell type"
output: github_document
---

In ALS (LP00714, cortex nuclei), most high-confidence site-level TSS switches have a neuron
cluster favouring the downstream TSS, the downstream site rarely has a FANTOM5 CAGE peak, and
the genes are housekeeping genes. If that comes from reads that stop short of the 5' end, a
gene like GAPDH or ACTB should show, in neurons, read 3' ends at the same polyA site as in
other cells but read 5' ends spread downstream of the TSS.

Reads are taken per gene with LRAA's read filters and strand rule
(`util/sc/read_end_profile_by_cluster.py`), kept if their introns are annotated introns of
the gene, and placed along the gene's main annotated transcript (the one most reads match
exactly). Positions are nt from that transcript's 5' end. Because GENCODE models can extend
past where reads start (RPL28's main model starts ~590 nt upstream), each read's start is
also measured from the gene's **observed TSS**, the most common read-start position (10 nt
bins) within the main transcript's first exon, over all cells of the dataset (anchored to the
first exon because in some genes truncated reads pile up near the 3' end and outnumber the
reads that start at the TSS), and its end from the most common read end. PBMC
(whole cells) is the contrast.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 10, dpi = 120)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r data}
als_class = c("0" = "Oligodendrocyte", "3" = "Oligodendrocyte", "1" = "Excitatory neuron", "8" = "Excitatory neuron",
              "4" = "Inhibitory neuron", "6" = "Inhibitory neuron", "2" = "Astrocyte", "7" = "Astrocyte", "12" = "Astrocyte",
              "5" = "Microglia", "9" = "OPC", "10" = "Vascular / meningeal", "11" = "Vascular / meningeal",
              "13" = "Vascular / meningeal")
pbmc_class = c("1" = "Monocyte / DC", "11" = "Monocyte / DC", "13" = "Monocyte / DC", "6" = "B", "9" = "B",
               "3" = "CD4 T", "7" = "CD4 T", "0" = "CD4 T", "5" = "CD4 T", "12" = "CD4 T",
               "2" = "CD8 T / NK", "4" = "CD8 T / NK", "8" = "CD8 T / NK", "10" = "CD8 T / NK")
als_order = c("Excitatory neuron", "Inhibitory neuron", "Oligodendrocyte", "OPC", "Astrocyte", "Microglia", "Vascular / meningeal")
pbmc_order = c("Monocyte / DC", "B", "CD4 T", "CD8 T / NK")
label = function(d, ds) d %>% mutate(dataset = ds, cluster_n = sub("Cluster_", "", cluster),
                                     class = if (ds == "ALS") als_class[cluster_n] else pbmc_class[cluster_n])

reads = bind_rows(label(read_tsv("ALS.reads.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE), "ALS"),
                  label(read_tsv("PBMC.reads.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE), "PBMC"))
lengths = bind_rows(label(read_tsv("ALS.lengths.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE), "ALS"),
                    label(read_tsv("PBMC.lengths.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE), "PBMC"))
mode10 = function(x) { x = x[!is.na(x)]; b = floor(x / 10) * 10; as.numeric(names(which.max(table(b)))) + 5 }
reads = reads %>% group_by(dataset, gene) %>%
    mutate(obs_tss = mode10(five_prime_tx_pos[five_prime_tx_pos <= first_exon_len[1] + 30]),
           obs_end = mode10(three_prime_tx_pos),
           start_offset = five_prime_tx_pos - obs_tss, end_offset = three_prime_tx_pos - obs_end,
           reaches_tss = abs(start_offset) <= 50, reaches_end = abs(end_offset) <= 50) %>% ungroup()
```

## 1. Read lengths, genome-wide sample, by cluster

```{r lengths, fig.height = 4.5}
ls = lengths %>% group_by(dataset, cluster_n, class) %>%
    summarize(n = n(), median_len = median(aligned_len), q25 = quantile(aligned_len, 0.25),
              q75 = quantile(aligned_len, 0.75), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(lengths, aes(reorder(paste0("C", cluster_n), aligned_len, median), aligned_len, fill = class)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2000)) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_x") + labs(x = NULL, y = "aligned read length (nt)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
knitr::kable(ls %>% arrange(dataset, median_len), digits = 0)
```

## 2. Where reads start and end, per gene

Each panel: read 5' starts (left) and 3' ends (right) along the gene's main transcript, by
cell type, as a share of that cell type's reads. Dashed line: the observed TSS / end.

```{r ends, fig.height = 13}
plot_ends = function(ds, order) {
    d = reads %>% filter(dataset == ds) %>% mutate(class = factor(class, levels = order)) %>%
        select(gene, class, start = five_prime_tx_pos, end = three_prime_tx_pos, obs_tss, obs_end) %>%
        pivot_longer(c(start, end), names_to = "which", values_to = "pos") %>% filter(!is.na(pos)) %>%
        mutate(which = factor(which, levels = c("start", "end"), labels = c("read 5' start", "read 3' end")))
    ref = d %>% distinct(gene, which, obs_tss, obs_end) %>%
        mutate(x = if_else(which == "read 5' start", obs_tss, obs_end))
    ggplot(d, aes(pos, after_stat(density), color = class)) +
        geom_freqpoly(binwidth = 25, linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_vline(data = ref, aes(xintercept = x), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
        facet_wrap(gene ~ which, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
        labs(x = "position along main transcript (nt from its 5' end)", y = "density", color = NULL,
             title = ds) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
plot_ends("ALS", als_order)
```

```{r ends_pbmc, fig.height = 13}
plot_ends("PBMC", pbmc_order)
```

## 3. Share of reads reaching the TSS and the 3' end, by cell type

`reach TSS`: read starts within 50 nt of the observed TSS. `reach end`: read ends within
50 nt of the observed end. `median start offset`: nt downstream of the observed TSS.

```{r reach}
reach = reads %>% group_by(dataset, gene, class) %>%
    summarize(reads = n(), median_len = median(aligned_len), reach_TSS = mean(reaches_tss, na.rm = TRUE),
              reach_end = mean(reaches_end, na.rm = TRUE), median_start_offset = median(start_offset, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
ggplot(reach %>% filter(reads >= 30), aes(reach_TSS, reach_end, color = class, shape = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) + facet_wrap(~ gene) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "share of reads starting at the observed TSS", y = "share of reads ending at the observed end",
         color = NULL) + theme_bw()
knitr::kable(reach %>% arrange(gene, dataset, desc(reach_TSS)), digits = 2)
```

## 4. Per cluster (ALS)

```{r per_cluster}
pc = reads %>% filter(dataset == "ALS") %>% group_by(gene, cluster_n, class) %>%
    summarize(reads = n(), reach_TSS = mean(reaches_tss, na.rm = TRUE), reach_end = mean(reaches_end, na.rm = TRUE),
              median_len = median(aligned_len), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(pc %>% filter(reads >= 20), aes(reorder(paste0("C", cluster_n), reach_TSS), reach_TSS, fill = class)) +
    geom_col() + facet_wrap(~ gene, ncol = 3) + labs(x = NULL, y = "share of reads starting at the observed TSS", fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
```
